question: For the top 20 Citi Bike routes in 2016, which route is faster than yellow taxis and among those, which one has the longest average bike duration? Please provide the start station name of this route. The coordinates are rounded to three decimals.
sql:
-- Final query returning exactly 1 row: the route with longest avg bike duration among those faster than taxis
WITH top20_routes AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_name,
        end_station_name,
        COUNT(*) as trip_count,
        AVG(tripduration) as avg_tripduration,
        ROUND(AVG(start_station_latitude), 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(AVG(start_station_longitude), 3) as start_lon,
        ROUND(AVG(end_station_latitude), 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(AVG(end_station_longitude), 3) as end_lon
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE DATE(starttime) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-12-31'
    GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name
    ORDER BY trip_count DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
taxi_coords AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
        ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
        AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
    WHERE pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
      AND pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL
      AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
    GROUP BY ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3), ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3), 
             ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3), ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3)
)
SELECT 
    r.start_station_name,
    r.end_station_name,
    r.avg_tripduration as avg_bike_duration
FROM top20_routes r
JOIN taxi_coords t 
    ON r.start_lat = t.start_lat AND r.start_lon = t.start_lon 
   AND r.end_lat = t.end_lat AND r.end_lon = t.end_lon
WHERE r.avg_tripduration < t.avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY r.avg_tripduration DESC
LIMIT 1
